newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Volvo says opens office in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Volvo says opens office in Shanghai.

text.p: Volvo Penta Asia (Pte) Ltd, part of Sweden's AB Volvo, said on Tuesday it has opened a representative office in Shanghai, China.

The office is located in the new Pudong industrial zone, Volvo said in a statement. It will include a training centre for regional distributors, dealers, fleet owners and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs).
Volvo Penta currently supplies industrial engines and marine engines for ferries to China's southern provinces.

"The Shanghai representative office will enable us to become an inside player in China and to build and strengthen business relationships with our business partners in the PRC. We will be in a better position to support European and American OEMs who are selling their products in the PRC," said Anders Bevreus, president of Volvo Penta Asia.
